atlas_home_region_card.compact: 2010s and streaming-era rap, from trap's 808 grammar to prestige rap albums and melodic playlist dominance.
atlas_home_region_card.standard: It made hip-hop the central sound of contemporary pop culture and spread trap rhythm across global pop.
atlas_home_region_card.deep: 2010s and streaming-era rap, from trap's 808 grammar to prestige rap albums and melodic playlist dominance. It made hip-hop the central sound of contemporary pop culture and spread trap rhythm across global pop.

region_scene_page.compact: Modern rap absorbed southern trap production into the mainstream while streaming changed song length, release cadence, and the speed of influence.
region_scene_page.standard: Modern rap absorbed southern trap production into the mainstream while streaming changed song length, release cadence, and the speed of influence. Kendrick Lamar's Backseat Freestyle, Chief Keef feat. Lil Reese's I Don't Like, J. Cole feat. Miguel's Power Trip, and Migos' Versace give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Modern rap absorbed southern trap production into the mainstream while streaming changed song length, release cadence, and the speed of influence. The low end, hi-hat motion, vocal processing, and playlist repeatability are often as important as traditional verse craft. Kendrick Lamar's Backseat Freestyle, Chief Keef feat. Lil Reese's I Don't Like, J. Cole feat. Miguel's Power Trip, and Migos' Versace give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
